hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-only, one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions. The creator initializes a pool, seeds token-only liquidity across [MIN_TICK, currentTick], and can later withdraw the full position (principal and accrued fees) back to themselves. afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks are no-ops returning ZERO_DELTA.
